offering_description.value: Provides online and blended K-12 education programs, including full-time virtual public schools and career learning courses. Sells curriculum, teachers and learning platforms over the internet to public school systems and to families directly.

primary_products.value: online K-12 curriculum; learning platform software; career learning courses

primary_services.value: virtual school programs; teacher-led instruction; career and technical training

customer_segment.value: B2G: state-funded public school districts and charter schools that contract for programs; B2C: families enrolling students directly in virtual school programs and courses

end_markets.value: K-12 education; career and technical training

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-student payments from public schools and districts for virtual school programs; subscription: licensed curriculum and platform access for schools; transaction or usage fees: tuition and course fees paid by families and learners for career courses
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs virtual schools and instruction, taking per-student funding from districts and families; software / platform: online learning platform and curriculum used by students and teachers

geography_served.value: US national: public school programs across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: virtual school programs, online curriculum, career learning courses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams contracting with state and district education agencies; online: families enroll students in virtual programs over the internet

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state education rules and accreditation for public school programs, student data privacy laws
